rationale: The Court will likely adopt a functional, text-based reading of § 2503’s “other similar written instrument” clause to cover MoneyGram’s prepaid, retail/agent-sold instruments and apply the FDA’s purchase-state escheat rule, emphasizing Congress’s response to Pennsylvania v. New York and avoiding an incorporator-state windfall. Any separate writing is most likely to press a narrower limiting principle (to keep the FDA a targeted carveout) or to underscore separation-of-powers concerns about reviving federal common-law priority rules where Congress has spoken.
